Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is a prominent chemical enterprise situated in the Boxing Economic Development Zone, Binzhou, Shandong Province, China. Established with a commitment to innovation and excellence, the company has positioned itself as a leading manufacturer and supplier of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Cyclodextrins—cyclic oligosaccharides—are essential ingredients widely used across pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics, agriculture, and environmental industries due to their unique molecular properties and ability to enhance solubility, stability, and bioavailability of various compounds.

Boasting a modern production facility equipped with advanced technologies and rigorous quality control measures, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. produces a comprehensive range of cyclodextrins, including alpha, beta, and gamma cyclodextrin, as well as various modified derivatives such as hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin and sulfobutyl ether-β-cyclodextrin. With a team of experienced professionals and a culture rooted in research and development, the company consistently drives technological advancements and delivers products that meet both domestic and international standards.

In addition to its strong focus on product quality and customer satisfaction, the company emphasizes sustainable practices and environmental stewardship, ensuring compliant and green operations throughout its manufacturing processes. With its strategic location in the heart of Shandong’s key economic development zone and a robust logistics network, Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd. is well-positioned to serve clients across China and around the globe, earning a reputation for reliability, integrity, and innovation in the chemical sector.
